title: Specified Weil exchange data for chosen dualizing objects
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$, an algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated and of finite type, with $X_0,Y_0$ separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be its geometric base change. For $T=X,Y,s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, use the common-stage category $\mathcal C_T=D^b_c(T,\Omega)$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and its geometric-Frobenius fixed-pair category $\mathrm W(T_0)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Operations mean the common-stage pullback, direct image, compact support, tensor and internal Hom [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], with their standard Weil lifts. Use their canonical lifted constructible exceptional adjoints [cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance]. Choose arbitrary structure adjunctions $Ra_{T,0!}\dashv J_T$ on the pair categories and put $\omega_T=J_T\Omega_{s_0}$, $D_T=R\mathcal Hom_T(-,\omega_T)$. Write $J_T^{\rm can}$ for the canonical structure right adjoint and $n_T:\omega_T\xrightarrow{\sim}J_T^{\rm can}\Omega_{s_0}$ for the counit-compatible comparison. Let $G_f$ be the canonical geometric constructible right adjoint of $Rf_!$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], with its standard Weil lift.

The ordinary adjunction $f^*\dashv Rf_*$ restricts to the pair categories with its ordinary unit, counit and Hom bijections. Let $c_f^{\rm can}:G_fJ_Y^{\rm can}\xrightarrow{\sim}J_X^{\rm can}$ be the right-adjoint mate of the compact-support composition isomorphism $Ra_{X!}\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra_{Y!}Rf_!$ [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Then
$$c_f=n_X^{-1}\circ(c_f^{\rm can})_{\Omega_{s_0}}\circ G_f(n_Y):G_f\omega_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_X$$
is an isomorphism of Weil pairs. For $M\in\mathrm W(X_0)$ put $A=R\mathcal Hom_Y(Rf_!M,\omega_Y)$. The successive exceptional, tensor--Hom and ordinary adjunction transposes of
$$Rf_!(M\otimes^Lf^*A)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{f,M,A}^{-1}}Rf_!M\otimes^LA\xrightarrow{\operatorname{ev}}\omega_Y$$
define a Weil morphism $\tau_M:A\to Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(M,G_f\omega_Y)$, natural contravariantly in $M$. Here $\operatorname{PF}$ is the specified projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula]. Every object and transpose displayed lies in the bounded constructible categories. In particular
$$e_M=Rf_*R\mathcal Hom_X(M,c_f)\circ\tau_M:D_YRf_!M\longrightarrow Rf_*D_XM$$
is a natural Weil morphism. These assertions concern the specified maps and use only constructible exceptional adjoints; no ambient exceptional-adjoint admissibility is imposed. No invertibility of $\tau_M$ or $e_M$ is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain Data from lem-sf-weil-chosen-exchange-construction. This supplies the normalized Hom lifts, constant pair, specified projection and compositor, with no exchange law.

Unfold the explicitly constructed ordinaryAdjunction and IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIsoAdjunction. Units and counits have the original carrier maps by reflexivity. Expand homEquiv_unit and homEquiv_counit, eliminate each given carrier HEq, and conclude both Hom-bijection carrier formulas by reflexivity.

For arbitrary chosen structure right adjunctions use the existing chosenComparison: rightAdjointUniq, conjugateIsoEquiv and composition of isomorphisms construct exactly the specified Weil comparison. The three-transpose components form tau by lem-sf-weil-chosen-transpose-naturality.

Map chosenComparison.hom under the flipped curried Hom bifunctor to obtain a natural transformation, then whisker it by Q. Compose this with tau. The tau_app and exchange_app formulas are definitional. Package this Exchange for all chosen adjunctions together with the proved OrdinaryMaps. No inverse of tau or exchange is used.
